youtube_title: Sleepy At 3 Pm Every Day? It's Your Lunch | Body Fix #16 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #16. 3 PM after lunch, eyes closing? Head nodding in the meeting?
B is right. A natural afternoon dip + a HEAVY carb lunch.
Big plate of rice/roti plus fried stuff = a harder crash.
Fix: Smaller lunch, more protein and veg, a 10 MIN walk after, full sleep at night.
Red flags: Sleepy after 8 hrs, dozing while driving, very thirsty? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Sleep Foundation - post-lunch dip
